svg.aria-label: One release-46 play decision, drawn from a live lead in room ADKY: seat 3 holds 3, 5, 7, 8, Q, A of clubs and the jack of diamonds; the S17 belief model gives each hidden card's holder probabilities (26.9 ms); 66 worlds are drawn, 2 rejected as history-illegal, 64 kept; 8 of 64 legal plays are admitted with their policy log-odds; the value head scores each candidate in each world and the mean picks the ace of clubs (1.799); the exact endgame (7 or fewer cards per hand) solves all 64 worlds in 0.197 s and switches to the jack of diamonds (1.797 vs 1.719 levels), played in 0.49 s. The value step is 512 positions (values) in 4 forward calls (batches of 128); the exact step makes no network call: 429,026 nodes, 173,315 cache hits. On one world, the true deal, the exact search after the J of diamonds finds the bot team's best lead 3 of clubs (attackers 45, +1 level), queen of clubs 50, ace of clubs 65.
